<p class="lead-copy">I'm an MS student in Biostatistics at Columbia University. Before Columbia, I studied Applied Statistics at the University of California, Davis.</p>

I work with R, Python and Excel to organize data, explore patterns and explain results. My experience includes sales and market analysis, a cost optimization project, and a student fitness organization at UC Davis.

I started at Columbia in September 2026 and expect to graduate in June 2028. This site brings together my background and a small collection of data work.
